summary: Integrated Media Technology Limited, an Australian-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of extraordinary general meeting and proxy form for a meeting on 25 November 2026 in Adelaide. The sole ordinary resolution seeks shareholder approval under section 254H of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) for a share consolidation at a ratio of not less than 1-for-2 and not more than 1-for-10, with the exact ratio and effective date (no later than 31 July 2027) set by the board; fractional entitlements round down. No price, stake, premium or advisor is stated. This is a routine meeting notice plus capital-structure housekeeping, not a special situation; watch the chosen ratio and any Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance implications.
